notes.title: 🗺️ Final Update for Rooms of Realities is now available 🌊
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Adventurers: it's time for the finishing touches in Rooms of Realities[/h2]

[u][b]Some history:[/b][/u]

🔎Do you remember how it all started? First, we prepared a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3725082316354679491]demo[/url] of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and on June 13, 2023, we launched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3683428365976521588]Early Access[/url] of the game. In that version, the entire "In the Shadows of the Pyramid" scenario was available. We were also ready for your feedback and to introduce further corrections and stories into the game.

Then, following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471427349049]the roadmap[/url], we introduced further improvements to the game, as well as a new scenario, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471471427224]"The Forsaken Asylum"[/url] (in July), and the final set of escape rooms collected in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3650783611420245966]"Nemo's Mysterious Formula"[/url] scenario (in August). This progression culminated in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/6187444440715974360]release of the full version of the game[/url] on November 17, 2023, which included, among other features, Victory Rooms that allow you to pose for fancy, cool photos after completing the scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/fe16bce796fe078e026781ba43dae04da817fe3a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]What now:[/b][/u]

🔎Almost half a year has passed since the release of the full version of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and this project continues to bring us immense joy. We are pleased to announce another update aimed at enhancing the aspect of the game you've most frequently inquired about - extending the duration of the third act in the "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario.

[b]The Final Update[/b] also enhances interactions with certain items, especially levers, and optimizes game physics, particularly during online play with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/2eff0a10ac5ff244c8a9660c8d343a888af4cd9a.jpg[/img]

[b][u]What’s next?[/u][/b]

🔎We know that many of you enjoyed our approach to virtual Escape Rooms and that some of you would like to see more [b]Rooms of Realities[/b]. Currently, we are not yet ready to reveal our future plans, but stay tuned to see what else we come up with in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

[i]~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: ☕️How we prepared Posters for Rooms of Realities
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/e9b756f20c3896ea2448f8f751b2698ed629cbb9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Today, we will tell you about how we prepared the posters that accompany you inside the game.[/h3]

As you can easily see, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/]Rooms of Realities[/url][/b] is a game consisting of rooms placed in three environments: Asylum, Egypt, and a mysterious submarine.

In our lore, however, players meet in their friend's basement (which serves as a lobby) to choose a cassette from which they will play a movie that takes them on a joint adventure. Since we have chosen this method of presenting transportation to fantastic worlds, we have prepared special posters for each of them, which also appear on the wall as the game progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/00116b1c242a40983975cf73b6fca0b3d9a35300.jpg[/img]

✴️We start, of course, with the "[b]In the Shadow of the Pyramids[/b]" scenario, inspired by classic adventure cinema. The characters on the poster are clearly working together to find a solution to a mystery, whether through books or observation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/909a2c72b96131f978ceb5c981dc7cc6ee150e26.jpg[/img]

✒️The next poster was created for "[b]The Forsaken Asylum[/b]" scenario. We wanted to show that despite the spooky atmosphere of the place we take the players to, the adventure remains light and humorous:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/b25a1f99703b107d11b8536fbdf05e4d6cd58da4.jpg[/img]

⚓️The poster for the "[b]Nemo's Mysterious Formula[/b]" scenario focuses on the characters taking over the reins. Since this is the third adventure for them (and for the players), we wanted to show not only the new environment but also the confidence radiating from the adventurers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/b5694aa550e850942a2defe46af80abb629cc9f0.jpg[/img]

📞[b]Let us know which poster you liked the most and why! [/b]We are moving forward and would like to hear your opinion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

[i]Bluekey & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: ☀️Welcome to the road to the sun! 💌

[list]
[*] [b]It's time to peek under the hood of European automotive classics; or rather, under the hood of our emotion-filled arcade racer💌[/b]

notes.title: Sunrise GP will land in 2024 on Steam!
notes.content:

Introducing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0][b]Sunrise GP[/b][/url] - Your Ultimate Roadtrip Adventure on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0

If you're a fan of arcade racing, a lively atmosphere, and the joy of multiplayer gaming on a split screen, buckle up and join us for the ride!

We’re back, Cosmonauts

While gathering feedback from our community, we found out that you need new challenges and that you like swinging around space stations so much - Following our recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1969000/view/3745363008535929265?l=english]"Comfort Zone"[/url] Update aimed at enhancing your gaming experience, we're here with some cosmic news – [b]it's time for the "Pick Your Challenge Update."[/b]

[h3]Introducing Difficulty Levels and Modifiers[/h3]

So, what’s new? Now, you have the power to tailor the challenge to your liking with our [b]newly minted difficulty levels:[/b]

🌟 Easy: In this setting, the game is exceptionally forgiving, and your adversaries won't drain your energy as swiftly.
🌟 Normal: The current difficulty level you're familiar with.
🌟 Hard: Brace yourself for an intense cosmic ride! In this mode, the slightest misstep could mean instant peril. It's a realm exclusively for the most skilled astronauts among you!

We've also introduced something even more captivating: [b]a total of nine options to fine-tune the game's difficulty, [/b]allowing everyone to set their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/][b]Yupitergrad 2[/b][/url] experience to their liking.

[h3]Here are the settings you can now find in the game options menu:[/h3]

💥 Enemies bullets speed - Adjust the rate of fire for enemy projectiles.
💥 Enemies damage - Customize the lethality of enemy bullets.
💥 Enemies health - Set the health levels for opponents.
💥 Enemies movement speed - Modify the agility and pace of enemy movements.
💥 Enemies shield - Define the resilience of enemy shields.
💥 Enemies shield orb spawn probability - Control the likelihood of shield orbs spawning.
💥 Minigun overheat time - Fine-tune the cooling time for your minigun.
💥 Traps damage - Determine the severity of trap effects.
💥 Closed atmospheric levels - Enhance maneuverability within enclosed atmospheric environments.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Yupitergrad 2[/url] was originally designed with a singular difficulty level in mind, making the task of adapting more difficulty levels, and variables a cosmic puzzle in itself. Nevertheless, we've tuned various gameplay elements to ensure that everyone, from seasoned space acrobats to professional adventurers, can relish the Yupitergrad 2 experience.

🤖Now, after this update, we are excited to see even more people enjoying the exhilaration of swinging around [b]The Lost Station[/b].🤖

Stay with us and wait for more news about what we are preparing in the future. Supporting our games is a key priority for us - and we're already full of ideas about what else we can do.

Have fun, astronauts!

[h3]🎖️About the game[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Yupitergrad 2[/url] is an action adventure game in which you move around an abandoned space station using suction cups attached to ropes. Wait, but that’s just the beginning! You’ll also have jets (nozzles) to maneuver in the air, and a set of powerful weapons to eliminate cheesy robotic opponents.

The game consists of everything a good VR adventure should have: [b]environmental puzzles, hostile enemies, exciting combat system, lots of gadgets and some easter eggs with some strong vibes of metroidvania games.[/b]

Not only that, the light and humorous tone of the game will definitely keep you engaged through the whole experience. 

[h3]⭐What's new in Yupitergrad 2?[/h3]

It's full of new ideas - we built this game according to the principle of "more & better".

First of all, we focused on the open structure of the space base, in which you should look for ways to open further passages. We will encounter rebellious machines to fight and shoot at with our new weapons. Our hero will use various helpful gadgets to maneouvre the game world, and his companion AIsha will finally appear on the screen!

All this together creates a new, more adventurous atmosphere and the feeling of actually taking part in a great space adventure in VR.

[h3]🐸Do I need to know Yupitergrad 1 to enjoy the sequel?[/h3]

Yupitergrad 2 very gently refers to the first part, being a completely new story. We took an approach similar to games like Mario or Zelda - where each part is a separate entity, but takes some basics and expectations from its predecessor.

[h3]⚡️Game access and release[/h3]
The release is now set for the first half of 2023. The game will be available on [b]Pico Neo headsets[/b], and a little later on [b]Meta Quest 2[/b]. Further platforms, including [b]Steam[/b] and [b]HTC Vive XR Elite[/b], will have release dates after the release on Quest 2.
 
Also, we'll soon be sending the trial version to the press and influencers, so you can check out their impressions online before the full release so stay tuned!

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40000399/a5ed40420fb326778a11ec85ddd73ebb7dabc99a.gif[/img]
[b]Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station[/b] is the next step in the development of VR games and our studio. We want to prove with this title that free movement in 3D, [b]dynamic combat[/b], and unlocking passages can work well in virtual reality. In a few months, we will offer you our vision of [b]Metroidvania[/b], which you can immerse yourself in completely. All that will happen in a vast, and infinite cosmos. Far, far away.

This approach - to create a more ambitious, more complex, and simply bigger game is also connected with the fact that some of its elements are rebuilt and redesigned many times. 
Before we can show you another fragment of [b]Yupitergrad 2[/b] in the form of a video (as in the first trailer), we want to invite you for a small walk through the concept art on the basis of which we develop our title:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/b0aaadecf6778c49ed009113a073a6bef9fecf15.png[/img]

Yes, [b]Yupitergrad 2[/b] also has huge obstacles and windmills. We arrange them so that they make an additional impression with their scale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/6d544a48362079ea2f4e83bdc977d0304a349ea6.png[/img]

Is this a shooting range? I think so! Now that you have a gun, you should also have a place to exercise freely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/0ee3ab4387c80acac9079726d058ed38bc4e1c31.png[/img]

The new space station will use known puzzles in new, fresh colors. Such obstacles will be a great test of your skills and an opportunity to really feel the dynamics of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/8d53ff4c68bcaa6150bfdd72570b74d22d993ce4.png[/img]

This buddy is not an ordinary robot - he perfectly patrols the corridors and very often gets in our way. Pay attention to its turret, it is very similar to the one you will be fighting with!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/070f9a0b34affe558e06db7da02def819465964e.png[/img]

Docks are a place without which a space station does not exist. We hope you will see something fresh in our vision when you have the opportunity to fly over them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/4c98eced60bb9b6e56b05e0df12fddfd677d8484.png[/img]

One of the most important aspects of [b]Yupitergrad[/b] and [b]Yupitergrad 2[/b] is scale. Since the game is based almost entirely on moving on ropes with suction cups, each location must offer enough space. It is not easy in VR, especially with adequate information about where the player is and where to go next. notes.content:

During the development of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000]Yupitergrad[/url] we wanted to bring a real breakthrough to the world of [b]Virtual Reality[/b].

It was a challenge on which we focused all our strengths and resources and worked for months without rest. We finished the game, but it didn't quite feel like our entire, huge vision managed to find its way into (virtual) reality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/f3d326a818eb054b25029ac70e3c8f6a2de8850a.gif[/img]

The changes we dreamed about for a long time, made us return to the drawing board, and we realized that we cannot limit ourselves to creating only new additions to something that already exists.
[b]Because our dreams outgrew their container.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/f36b3a6131e29f1c695daebf65eec23a6ecce1f8.gif[/img]

Here’s why, instead of reshaping the original, we began working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000]Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station[/url], a true sequel that will allow us to boldly stand next to such important titles for Virtual Reality as Superhot, HL: Alyx or Population: One.
We want our new title to [b]prove[/b] that [b]Virtual Reality[/b] is [b]ready[/b] for real action-adventure games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/29959f02d0d720609dc3e45a84d1d643b33c59e6.gif[/img]

So what's changing? First of all, an extensive space base, with its own secrets to discover and robots that, for some reason, decided to attack us. During our journey, we will be accompanied by [b]AIsha[/b], a wonderful artificial intelligence whose voice and abilities will aid us during our exploration and traverse of the mysterious space station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/efb7281ecd56b07ee44295f76f9ab71e8cd97fd8.gif[/img]

We have thrown the features of modern [b]Metroidvania[/b] into our workshop and decided to transfer, first time in video games history, them to Virtual Reality. And we can't wait for you to play it!

Therefore, please be with us and wait for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000]Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station[/url]. We love sci-fi movies, games that take us to space stations, and books about traveling to the stars - we will do everything to make this passion noticeable also in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000]Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station[/url].

notes.title: [0.3.0] Early Access Overhaul Update Nr 2
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! [/b]

[b]It took a litlle bit longer, but we are introducing a lot of changes with this update that cover a lot of feedback we had received. Here are the most important changes:[/b] 

[list][*][b]New improved home planet[/b]
Finally Spuds get a place to live. Gather your galactic tribe back togeteher and unlock new houses for them on your home planet. A lot of the devices have been simplified and are now much faster to use, allowing you to go to combat in a very straightforward manner.

[*] [b]Removed playdust container and token exchanger from the home planet[/b] 
Spuds are the real currency now, you don’t have to pay attention to playdust level anymore. We feel this makes the game much easier to understand.

[*] [b]Create the largest population in the whole galaxy![/b]
Free imprisoned Spuds and Spuds Heroes to make home planet great again! You will free Spuds from the planets in the galaxy and make them join you. However be careful as when other players will conquer your planets, some of the Spuds will relocate to the better ruler!

[*] [b]Conquer planets to get token rewards.[/b]
[b]On different planets you will find token artifacts that will allow you to get new weapons.[/b]

[*] [b]New turrets production system.[/b]
Just choose a combination and you are ready to go. No need to do more than neccessary.

[*] [b]Combat re-balance: new enemy units and new Spuds skills.[/b]
Signifcant changes have been made to the difficulty levels. There are new units involved and the skills for Spuds changed a lot. Turrets also behave differently. This is just a starting point, as we are already adding an adjusting difficulty level.

[*] [b]Optimization and other minor fixes.[/b]
With this update you should see a dramatic improvement in performance. We have done a lot to make the game as smoothly as possible.[/list]

[b]Stay tuned for more info![/b]

notes.title: [0.2.0] Total Early Access Overhaul Update, Combat Rebalance + MORE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/ba5e98cb41d93ef1d82a9ad2a2f329e3bda1de89.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hello Conquerors,[/b]

0.2.0, our greatest update of all is here for you to discover with complete combat overhaul, lack of subsystems and many changes listed below:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Removed subsystems and the subsystem charging factory [/b]from the home planet. You no longer need to charge your subsystems with goonbots and build vehicles. Goonbots are now infinite and are always a part of your defense system. Vehicles are now attached to your Spud class - deploying a Spud to the battlefield will transform him into a proper vehicle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/b77e959e6391307eb61c8b1715d40ac25c0b4309.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/d774153c332ee7b06c88604e4565347f66d251a8.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/ba5e98cb41d93ef1d82a9ad2a2f329e3bda1de89.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Introduced Spud upgrades.[/b] All Spuds (apart from the regulars) can now be upgraded - with each upgrade they get either better combat statistics or new abilities. Use the Spud upgrade center to change your regulars into the class you want. Use a Spud token of the same type multiple times to upgrade your spud.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/386c94dce39b45a09d993d7e39cb57c4d1ff228e.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Streamlined use of Spuds and their combat behavior [/b]- you now only throw your Spuds to the battlefield. They will land precisely where you throw them and they will behave more in line with their combat role. Upon landing they will occupy the land zone for a certain amount of time.

[*] [b]Goonbots are now the only units that can destroy the enemy extractors and defense systems.[/b] Upon closing the gap between them they will detonate themselves to damage them. Use your turrets and spuds to help them reach their destination.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34050739/09d81b96b709b3c8a5e61d519e4428361207b86f.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added a decal system[/b] - the explosions and bullets will now damage the battlefield. The zombuds will spill their rotten juices upon death. 

[*] [b]Added muzzle flashes to certain weapons.[/b]

[*] [b]Significantly improved pathfinding [/b]- our pathfinding system based on flowfields will now produce very nice and straight paths to destinations.

[*][b] Various minor bugfixes.[/b]

[*][b] Introduced color palette[/b] to the units so now you can easily differ if they're friendly or not.

[*] [b]Significant performance optimizations [/b]- all assets have been heavily optimized, specifically the Spuds and the home planet buildings.

[*] [b]New Spud AI on the home planet[/b] - the Spuds now interact with each other and find new interesting paths on the home planet.

[*] [b]Various new sound effects[/b] for all of your interactions (all spuds and vehicles have visual differences per level ).
[/list]
